# teams agent user permissions list

List an agentic user's agent identity's directly-granted delegated permissions

## Usage

```
teams agent user permissions list <userIdOrUpn> [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `userIdOrUpn` | Agentic user’s object ID or UPN | Yes |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
